newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar ends firmer in light trading.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar ends firmer in light trading.

text.p: ---------------------MARKET COMMENT-------------------------- * Canada's dollar firmed to close on Monday at C$1.3876 (US$0.7204) from Friday's close of C$1.3885 (US$0.7202) in light trading, dealers said. * They said the currency was stuck in a narrow range and unlikely to strengthen much as long as Canadian interest rates remained below those in the United States.
Farrill said the Canadian dollar failed to strengthen last week despite economic data seen as positive for the currency.
"That was the opportunity for the Canada (dollar) to do better and when it didn't do better, people concluded that it's not going to do better," Farrill said.

The Canadian dollar has fallen about four percent against the U.S. dollar this year, while the mid-point of the Bank of Canada's range for overnight financing remained about 250 basis points lower than the U.S. federal funds rate.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar eased 82.56 yen from Friday's close of 82.67 yen and dipped to 1.2361 marks from 1.2430 marks.
